d:
Enjoy The Beautiful Kannada Lyrical Song “Mallige Hoovanthe” From The Classic Movie Ondhu Mutthina Kathe, Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Archana.
Watch And Enjoy The Lyrics Of This Evergreen Kannada Melody And Relive The Nostalgic Magic Of Classic Kannada Cinema.
For Everyone Who Loves Dr. Rajkumar Songs, Kannada Old Songs, Kannada Lyrical Songs, Evergreen Kannada Melodies And Classic Kannada Movie Songs.
Directed by: Shankar Nag
Produced by: A. Dwarakanath, A. Ramadas, A. S. Murthy, D. K. K. Prasad
Written by: Shankar Nag
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Archana
Music Director: L. Vaidyanathan
